notes.title: Major update of "The Last Secret"
notes.notes:
[p]The game now has a new Japanese translation, thanks to the efforts of Tanisikinngyo.  If you have Japanese friends, then please let them know that now is the perfect time to play "The Last Secret"![/p][p]Besides that, we caught a lot of bugs for all language versions and fixed them.[/p][p]Have fun with "The Last Secret"! 
(And if you've played it already, please try out the prequel "[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309230/Sweet_Science__The_Girls_of_Silversee_Castle"]Sweet Science[/url]".)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308168/ba3cdb1446361f5864e61978e8e62ed292a399c4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Small bug patch Japaese version
notes.notes: Repaired a bug in Chapter 2 in the Japanese version.

notes.title: Corrections on Japanese version
notes.notes: Mistakes in the first part of the game in the Japanese version have been fixed.

notes.title: Japanese version
notes.notes: We have made some bug fixes for the Japanese language version. We are currently also working on improving the Japanese version further, pleased stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Updated Chinese version
notes.notes: A few bugs in the Chinese language version have now been eliminated.

notes.title: Better English, better Spanish, better graphics, better game play
notes.notes:
We have improved the English version of the game, fixed a few minor issues with the Spanish translation. Also, we have improved some graphics, in particular the romantic hike CG with Karina. We have made it also a bit easier to enter Karina's route. Hope you'll enjoy it! :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308168/5a1ff806270694db79828fe2085a462befb7e806.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Improved English translation and some bug fixes
notes.notes: We have improved some lines in the English translation. Also, some minor bugs, and in particular one interaction at the bus stop that shouldn't be there (depending on previous choices) has been fixed.

notes.title: Minor fix for Russian
notes.notes: There were two small bugs in the Russian version which are now fixed. In particular, the sub titles for the song "conspiracies" are now available in Russian as well.

notes.title: Another big udpate! – Especially for Ukrainian and Russian language!
notes.notes:
Thanks to a super nice and diligent translator (Clavik1), The Last Secret is now fully available in Ukrainian and Russian! The previous automatic translation has been replaced and you can now fully enjoy the game in these languages.
What? You're not speaking any of these languages? Well, then you can at least enjoy the improved editor at the true ending of the game and numerous bug fixes!
So why not give it a try now? It's free, and waiting for you! :)

notes.title: Minor bug fixes.
notes.notes: Small bug fixes (one picture of Meilin was wrong, easier to close the announcement of "Sweet Science" at the start of the program).

notes.title: "The Last Scret" – more and better!
notes.notes:
Thanks to lots of players feedback, we have improved the game. Moreover, we added a new song, and finally the Spanish translation is now complete!
By the way, we have a new game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309230/Sweet_Science__The_Girls_of_Silversee_Castle]Sweet Science - The Girls from Silversee Castle[/url]. Please check it out!

notes.title: Something new in the final ending... and a present! (Update 19 October 2022)
notes.notes:
We have added some new graphics to the final ending. And, important for vivid players who like to try all routes: after completing the game, every time you start Chapter 15, you have now the choice to replay one of the routes you had previously completed or simply proceed with the game. This means, you won't have to worry anymore about finishing the game: you can always replay old endings.
Besides that I have fixed a number of bugs – graphics, language, sound etc.
And something else: the plans for our next game will be announced very soon. If you want to know more, then subscribe on our mailing list: [url=tinyurl.com/TheLastSecret]tinyurl.com/TheLastSecret[/url] – and get a present!

notes.title: Go stones are back! - Update 8 October 2022
notes.notes:
[i]Sometimes if you fix one bug, a new one emerges...
[/i]
That just happened to me: after fixing a few wrong words in the German translation, the English version suddenly showed these German lines. This is now fixed.
Moreover, an update of Ren'Py broke the mouse cursor changes. I didn't notice that at first, but now it is fixed and you will see, e.g., a Go stone when you are supposed to put one on the board.
I have also made minor improvements to the English translation.
Hope you'll enjoy the update!

notes.title: Further improvements for the Chinese version! (7 Oct 2022)
notes.notes:
The Chinese version is now debugged up to the end of the game. (Of course I will still keep keep an eye open for more potential bugs.)
There have also been a few smaller graphics and sound glitches that have been improved, like the overly loud background noise in the second cockpit scene on the "Heart of Gold". Hope you'll enjoy the game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wydC8nu.png[/img]

notes.title: 30 September Update: More Fun, Fewer Bugs!
notes.notes:
We have smoothed out some of the music, fixed a few graphics glitches and text errors and also improved the Chinese translations up to Chapter 10.

We thank all the supporters of the game "The Last Secret" who helped with translations, proof reading or bug reports. Some of them (and also the first player who finished the game after release) are now included in the game: here you can find them as fans of "Cool Magic"!  
Thanks and congrats! :)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hcFqcAb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 25, 2022
notes.notes: We have improved the Chinese version substantially. We also made a number of minor bug fixes throughout the game. Thanks for everybody who made suggestions for improvements!

notes.title: Update Notes for 20 September 2022
notes.notes:
In the new update you can skip mini games that you have successfully mastered before. So if you redo the story, you can just skip the work and enjoy the fun. You can, of course, also decide to replay the mini games.

I have also improved the English translation further, fixed some minor errors and made the rainbow option a bit more obvious (on request of some players who simply didn't know that they had to activate it).

notes.title: Update Notes for 17 September 2022
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes for the English translation (in particular in the Anna arc), thanks to the reports by Zaka.

notes.title: Update notes for 16 September 2022
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players of The Last Secret,[/b]
thanks to your excellent feedback I could fix a number of smaller errors. Most of them were only small spelling or layout mistakes, but there were also two bad bugs - one after the lunch date scene with Ben and one during the tent scene with Meilin. They should be fixed now as well.
If you find anything else, please let me know, I'll take care of it as soon as possible! 
Suki also provided more improvements for the Spanish translation.
Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Notes for 8 September 2022
notes.notes: We have corrected some minor issues in the English translation. We also adjusted the volume of the song "Tomodachi" at the beginning of Chapter 1.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes (Final ending, Chapter 14 achievement)
notes.notes: Corrected some bugs at the final ending (English version) and the missing Chapter 14 achievement. Sorry, I was stupid for not finding that earlier!
